title: Acute Diarrhoea Assessment
candidateBrief: You are a doctor in a GP surgery. David Hughes, 35, has come in about diarrhoea for three days. Take a focused history. You have 8 minutes.

patient.name: David Hughes
patient.persona: An employed accountant who lives with his wife and two children, speaks clearly and provides detailed responses when questioned, remains cooperative throughout the consultation.
patient.openingLine: I've had diarrhoea for the last three days and it's been affecting my day-to-day activities.

rubric.label: Introduces self and explains the purpose of the conversation
rubric.exampleQuestion: Hello, I'm one of the doctors. Is it okay if I ask you some questions today?

rubric.label: Opens with an open question and lets the patient speak
offlineCues: what can i do for you

rubric.label: Asks when it started and how it has changed
rubric.exampleQuestion: When did this start, and has it changed since?

rubric.label: Asks what it is like and how bad it is
rubric.exampleQuestion: What does it feel like, and how bad does it get?

rubric.label: Asks about associated symptoms
rubric.exampleQuestion: Have you noticed anything else along with it?

rubric.label: Takes a past medical history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Do you have any medical conditions, or have you had any operations?

rubric.label: Asks about medicines and allergies
rubric.exampleQuestion: Are you taking any medicines, and do you have any allergies?

rubric.label: Asks about family history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Does anything like this run in your family?

rubric.label: Takes a smoking and alcohol history
rubric.exampleQuestion: Do you smoke, and how much alcohol do you drink in a week?

rubric.label: Asks about work, home and daily life
rubric.exampleQuestion: What do you do for work, and who is at home with you?

rubric.label: Screens the systems relevant to the complaint
rubric.exampleQuestion: Any weight loss, fevers or night sweats?

rubric.label: Explores the patient's ideas, concerns and expectations
rubric.exampleQuestion: Is there anything in particular you are worried this might be?

rubric.label: Summarises, checks understanding and invites questions
rubric.exampleQuestion: Can I summarise what you have told me? Do you have any questions?

rubric.label: Says what to do if it gets worse
rubric.exampleQuestion: If it gets worse, or you feel much more unwell, call 111 or come straight back.

facts.text: I've had diarrhoea for the last three days.

source.quote: I've just had some diarrhea for the last three days

facts.text: It's been affecting my day-to-day activities and I need to stay close to the toilet.

source.quote: it's been affecting me I need to stay close to the toilet. And, um, yeah, it's been affecting my day-to-day activities.

facts.text: My stools are loose and watery, and I go to the toilet about six or seven times a day.

source.quote: Yeah, so it's like loose and watery stool, going to the toilet quite often

facts.text: I have cramp-like pain in my lower left abdomen that comes and goes.

source.quote: it feels, um, like a cramp, like a muscular cramp

facts.text: I feel weak and shaky, especially when the symptoms started.

source.quote: yeah i feel a bit uh weak and shaky.

facts.text: I had a fever around three or four days ago when the symptoms started.

source.quote: I did notice um a temperature when the symptoms started, so, um, yeah around about three or four days ago.

facts.text: I vomited at the start of the symptoms but have now stopped vomiting.

source.quote: I vomited at the start of the symptoms but now um I've stopped vomiting.

facts.text: I've had a loss of appetite but I can still hold down fluids.

source.quote: I had a loss of appetite, um, so I haven't been eating as much, but I've been able to hold down fluids.

facts.text: I've been eating soups, smoothies and other liquid foods.

source.quote: just soups, and, uh, yeah, light foods. Like smoothies and, yeah, liquid foods mainly.

facts.text: I had takeaway from a Chinese restaurant about four days ago.

source.quote: Yeah, so I had takeaway about four days ago

facts.text: No one else in my household has had the same symptoms as me.

source.quote: no one else in the family, so ... a wife and two kids and one, um, child was vomiting, but they haven't got diarrhea. There's no one with the same symptoms.

facts.text: I have asthma but it is well-controlled with an inhaler.

source.quote: other than um athsma, um I use an inhaler, everything uh else is fine.

facts.text: I am not taking any other medications besides my inhaler.
I do not smoke or drink alcohol.
I work as an accountant and have been going to work despite the symptoms, which has been difficult.

source.quote: Uh, yes, yeah. I I work, er. Um, I'm an accountant.
